description: This file implements health check functionalities for a Kubernetes-based infrastructure, including node readiness, pod health, resource metrics, and network metrics, and reports generation.

classes.name: HealthReport
classes.description: Data class representing an aggregated health report including site, cluster, environment, timestamp, summary, details, and version.

classes.name: HealthChecker
classes.description: Class responsible for performing various health checks (node readiness, pod health, resource and network metrics) and generating a structured health report.

methods.name: None __init__( self, kctl: KubectlClient, site_id: str, cluster_id: str, env: str, include_details: bool = True, redact_sensitive: bool = True, metrics_flags: Optional[Dict[str, bool]] = None, logger=None, )
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HealthChecker with kubectl client and configuration parameters.

methods.name: Any _redact(self, value: Any)
methods.description: Internal method to mask sensitive information in provided values.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _node_readiness(self)
methods.description: Checks the readiness status of nodes, returning total nodes and a list of nodes not in 'Ready' condition.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _pods_health(self)
methods.description: Evaluates the health of pods, returning total pods, total restarts, and a list of unhealthy pods.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _resource_metrics(self)
methods.description: Collects resource usage metrics from the cluster if enabled.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _network_metrics_for_pod(self, ns: str, name: str)
methods.description: Simulates gathering network metrics for a specific pod by executing commands inside the pod.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _network_metrics(self)
methods.description: Collects network metrics for a sample of pods if enabled.

methods.name: HealthReport run(self)
methods.description: Performs all health checks, compiles a report with summary and detailed info, redacting sensitive data if configured.

ctags.signature: ( self, kctl: KubectlClient, site_id: str, cluster_id: str, env: str, include_details: bool = True, redact_sensitive: bool = True, metrics_flags: Optional[Dict[str, bool]] = None, logger=None, )
